name: That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles
source:
Elise Greene is a young and aspiring pâtissièrie, as well as the daughter of a family who owns a bakery renown in Panadería (a fictional town in Southern California) for the quality of their baked goods. She's going to inherit the family business in a couple of years since she's the oldest and only child in this generation of the family.

All is well until her parents start thinking about selling the bakery, and when Elise and her friends find out, they resolve to fight back and show her parents that small businesses can still stay afloat even in the toughest of economic times.

That's not all that happens during the year though; within this small town lay many secrets, and most don't stay so because of the notorious grapevine of gossip that weaves its way in nearly all social circles. Drama outside of the bakery's going to go down, and like it or not, Elise could get more involved in any of them…
translation: 艾莉丝·格林是一个有抱负的年轻糕点师，也是一个在帕纳德里亚（南加州的一个虚构小镇）以烘焙品质闻名的面包店家族的女儿。作为这一代家族中最年长的独生女，她将在几年后继承家族企业。一切都很好，直到她的父母开始考虑卖掉面包店。当艾莉丝和朋友们发现后，他们决心反击，向她的父母证明即使在最艰难的经济时期，小企业也能生存下去。不过这并不是这一年发生的所有事情；在这个小镇上隐藏着许多秘密，大多数秘密都无法隐藏，因为臭名昭著的八卦传播网几乎渗透了所有社交圈。面包店之外的戏剧也会上演，不管艾莉丝是否愿意，她都可能卷入其中……
